decisive_items: radiolucent resorptive lesions cervically on the palatal aspects of teeth #11 and #21, originating from the external palatal surface and perforating into the pulp space
asymptomatic irreversible pulpitis with normal apical tissues
response.rationale: The presence of radiolucent resorptive lesions on the palatal aspects of the teeth is a distinctive feature of external cervical resorption, which is the primary diagnosis. Asymptomatic irreversible pulpitis is also present, but it is a secondary condition related to the external cervical resorption.

rejected.why: Periodontitis is a separate condition that is also present, but it is not the primary diagnosis for the specific lesions on the central incisors.
